settings.section_subtitle: Rooted in tradition, crafted for modern living
settings.story_text:
Aela Daily was born from a simple belief: that beauty lies in imperfection. Founded in Berlin in 2026, we work directly with artisans across Asia to bring handcrafted wabi-sabi pieces into European homes.

Every table runner is hand-knotted over days. Every cotton rope basket is coiled with intention. These are not mass-produced items — they are objects with soul.

settings.label: Our Philosophy
settings.quote: "In a world of mass production, we choose slowness. Each knot tied with intention. Each fiber chosen with care. This is not just decor — it is a way of living."
settings.author: — Aela Daily
